name: Fetal lung T, NK and ILC cells (UMAP)
description: Single-cell RNA-seq of 4,778 T, NK and innate lymphoid cells from human fetal lung, shown on their UMAP with 14 annotated cell types.

source.citation: He P et al. (2022) A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators of epithelial fates. Cell. doi:10.1016/j.cell.2022.11.005
